ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate ratio of 0.08:1 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (dark) pixels across the visible ventral fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Localized high-contrast white clusters (5-15 pixel diameter) distributed across both lobes; highest density observed at distal tips; distinct linear white pixel streaks on the medial-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated 48-degree pixel angle; vertex is partially occluded by water splash but maintains a measurable depth of approximately 45 pixels relative to the highest points of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency serration pattern with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 8 pixels; one significant jagged irregularity (approx 15 pixel depth) located on the right lobe trailing edge, approximately 60 pixels from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a symmetrical concave sweep from the median notch to the distal tips; distal tips show an abrupt upward convex hook.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 40 circular high-contrast pixel rings (rosettes) distributed semi-randomly; concentration of 12 clusters at the left distal tip and 18 clusters across the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four parallel, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) ranging from 30 to 80 pixels in length, oriented diagonally across the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large textured high-intensity pixel clusters at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; extensive linear scarring on the right lobe surface.
